Franchise Royalty Fee | 6% of Gross Sales | Weekly | See Note 2 for definition of Gross Sales.
Marketing Fund | None currently; Up to 2.5% of Gross Sales, when Fund begins to operate | Weekly | See Notes 2 and 5.
Local Marketing Commitment | None currently; Greater of 2% of Gross Sales or $3,000 per month, if we make it a requirement | Monthly | See Note 3 and Item 11.
Digital Marketing Management | Currently $1,200 per month to Social Inbound Marketing (SIM) | Monthly | Payable directly to SIM, which is our affiliate. Subject to increase over time, no more than 10% per year.
Technology Fee | Currently $1,000 per year | Annually on July 1st | Fee will not exceed $1,500 per year.
Merchandise and Supplements for Resale | Merchandise: Not less than $1,000 every 3 months; Supplements: Quantity necessary to maintain inventory requirements | Monthly; As Incurred | Must carry Camp-branded merchandise and nutritional supplements from MyoFX.
Conference Registration Fee | Up to $500 per person, per conference | Annually | 1 person required to attend.
Late Payment Fees | $250 plus interest at 18% or highest legal rate | Upon Invoice
Insufficient Funds Fee | $100 per occurrence | Upon Invoice
Non-compliance Fee | Up to $1,000 per notice | Upon Invoice
Inspection Fee | Actual costs (estimated $750 per inspection) | Upon Invoice
Cure Period Extension Fee | $1,000 per curable event of default | Upon Invoice
Liquidated Damages | Average monthly Royalty, Marketing Fund, Digital Marketing Management, and other fees in preceding year x lesser of 12 or remaining months in term | Upon demand
